annotations.title: CPR costs rules lookup (Parts 3, 25, 36 and 44 to 47)

description: Looks up the costs rules of the Civil Procedure Rules in England and Wales, rule by rule, by number or by words: Parts 44 to 47 (general rules, fixed costs, special cases, detailed assessment), the costs rules of Part 36, costs budgeting and capping in Part 3 and security for costs in Part 25. Each rule comes back with its official heading, Part and Section, a plain-English summary, a practice note, its old number where it was renumbered (2023 and 2025), when it was omitted if it has been, a link to its text on legislation.gov.uk and the free DMD tool for it, if any. A word search works like the page's search box (every word must appear) and returns up to 5 rules. Reference only: it explains the rules and never assesses anyone's costs.

query.description: Words to find, as in the page's search box: a rule has to contain every word, e.g. "default costs certificate", "QOCS" or "interest". Up to 5 rules come back, closest first.

rule.description: A rule number, written any usual way: "44.11", "r.47.14", "CPR 3.15A" or "44.2(4)" (the paragraph is not used). An old number the page records is found too, e.g. "25.12" (now 25.26). Give it as text, so "44.10" keeps its 0.
